errors.generic: Something went wrong. Your data was not changed.

scope.label: View scope
scope.tooltip: Charts use the accounts currently in this scope over the whole interval. Changing group membership changes the view, not your history.

welcome.title: Track your crypto, read-only
welcome.body: Add public addresses to see balances, value and history. Portfolio Desk never asks for seed phrases or private keys and cannot send or sign transactions.
welcome.privacy: Everything is stored on this computer. Data sources you enable will see the public addresses they are asked about.

portfolio.excludedHint: Suspected spam is excluded from the total. It is not deleted.
portfolio.unrealizedHint: Current value of remaining holdings minus their acquisition cost basis.
portfolio.periodHint: Flow-adjusted change over the selected period (Modified Dietz). Deposits are not counted as gains.

chart.label: Portfolio value
chart.empty: No value history yet. History appears once balances are synchronized.

assets.title: Assets
assets.basisHint: Cost basis coverage for this position

activity.empty: No activity in this scope yet.

addAddress.title: Add a public address
addAddress.publicOnly: Enter a public address only. Never enter a seed phrase or private key.
addAddress.btcScope: A Bitcoin address is only part of an HD wallet. Add each receive and change address you want tracked; other addresses of the same wallet are not discovered.
addAddress.evmScope: The same EVM address can exist on several networks. Add it once per network you want tracked.
addAddress.duplicate: This address is already tracked. It was not added twice.

wallets.emptyBody: A wallet is a named container for one or more public addresses.

groups.explain: Groups are filters over wallets. A wallet can be in several groups and is counted once.
groups.scopeNote: Totals include each account once, even when wallets overlap with other groups.

settings.privacyHint: Masks balances and addresses on every screen.
settings.backupPending: Not available in this build yet.

sources.intro: Keys are stored in the operating system's credential store, never in the portfolio database, and are never shown again after saving. Providers see the public addresses they are asked about.

requirement.recommended: API key (recommended; anonymous access is slower)

sources.replacePlaceholder: Paste a new key to replace the saved one
sources.testUnavailable: Connection tests arrive with the provider adapters.
sources.adapterPending: Synchronization with this source is not implemented in this build yet.
sources.routing: Configured Alchemy takes priority for Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism and Polygon; Helius takes priority for Solana. Zerion serves other covered networks. Source errors keep cached data.

sync.unsupported: This network has no synchronization source in this build
sync.pendingIncomplete: Some pending transactions may be hidden by the provider's limit
sync.doneWithErrors: Synchronization finished with errors; see the accounts below

accounting.partialHint: Some movements have no value or classification yet; only the known part is shown.

reason.nonpositive_denominator: Not meaningful for this period (no invested capital)
reason.incomplete_classification: Some transfers are not classified yet

accounting.realizedHint: Proceeds minus FIFO cost basis of everything sold or spent.
accounting.incomeHint: Rewards and airdrops at their value when received.
accounting.expensesHint: Network fees and transfer costs at their value when paid.
accounting.totalIncomplete: Available once every part is complete

review.title: Review missing data
review.intro: Decisions here are saved as versioned overrides. The original blockchain data is never changed, and every figure is recalculated from history.

explain.unknown_basis: This receipt came from outside your tracked accounts. Add its acquisition cost, use the market value as an estimate, or pair it with a transfer.
explain.unclassified_outgoing: This asset left your tracked accounts. Say whether it was a transfer to your own account, a sale, a payment, a gift or a withdrawal.
explain.missing_proceeds: A sale or payment needs its proceeds to compute realized P&L.
explain.missing_price: No historical price was found for this time. Enter a unit price to value it.
explain.missing_trade_value: Neither side of this trade has a price. Enter the proceeds or a unit price.

review.empty: Nothing needs review in this scope.

reconciliation.opening_overlap: History replaced by an opening balance
reconciliation.orphaned_override: Decision no longer matches a movement

explain.inventory_gap: More was spent than the known history holds; earlier history or an opening balance is missing.
explain.balance_mismatch: The reported balance differs from the synchronized history.
explain.opening_overlap: Movements before the opening balance date are ignored for accounting.
explain.orphaned_override: The movement this decision referred to is no longer reported. The decision is kept in the audit history.
explain.invalid_pairing: A transfer pairing needs an outgoing and an incoming movement of the same asset in two of your accounts.

leg.noPair: Not a transfer between my accounts

leg.lotsHint: Lots may cover part of the receipt; the rest keeps an unknown basis.
leg.noHistory: No decisions saved for this movement.

asset.basisCoverage: {{percent}}% of quantity has a known basis
asset.lotsHint: Oldest lots are used first when the asset is sold or spent.

coverage.intro: What this build reads for each network, and what it leaves out. The status of each of your accounts is on the Wallets page.

limits.btc_single_address: One address per account; HD wallets (xpub) are not discovered.
limits.btc_pending_cap: Pending transactions beyond the provider's 50-record list may be hidden; this is marked on the account.
limits.zerion_simple_positions: Wallet balances only: DeFi deposits, lending positions and NFTs are not included in totals.
limits.zerion_interpreted_history: History as interpreted by Zerion: swaps and multi-step transactions become the account's movements; internal transfers appear only where Zerion reports them.
limits.polygon_native_contract: Native POL is reported under the system contract 0x…1010 and is treated as the native asset.
limits.solana_zerion_interpreted: History as interpreted by Zerion; rent deposits, wrapped SOL and closed token accounts are not separated or raw-verified.
limits.solana_token_2022: Token-2022 balances are included where Zerion reports them; transfer-fee extensions are not verified.
limits.tron_staked_included: Staked TRX (frozen, delegated or unfreezing) counts as part of the TRX holding; voting rewards count once claimed.
limits.tron_trc10_unsupported: TRC-10 tokens are not tracked; their transfers stay visible as partially decoded activity.
limits.tron_token_metadata: A TRC-20 balance appears once its decimals are known (from history, or a lookup of up to 10 tokens per sync).
limits.tron_unverified_tokens: TronGrid gives no token verification; tokens are priced only by contract address, never by symbol.
limits.ton_events_canonical: Each trace is one record (the TonAPI account event); its fee is net of refunds.
limits.ton_contract_calls_partial: Other contract calls show the TON sent but are marked partially decoded.
limits.ton_nft_excluded: NFT transfers are shown but not valued.
limits.ton_key_recommended: Works without a key at a slower rate; a free TonAPI key is recommended.
limits.alchemy_transfer_index: Transfer-indexed history misses failed calls, approvals and internal transfers; receipt logs supply ERC-20 legs and sender fees. Coverage stays partial.
limits.alchemy_bounded_discovery: Token discovery is limited to 8 pages / 50 nonzero tokens per sweep. Omitted balances stay stale after a capped scan.
limits.rpc_unverified_tokens: Tokens are unverified and identified by their contract or mint; a symbol is never used as identity.
limits.helius_full_history: History uses full finalized transactions and all related token accounts. Method access depends on the Helius account; unavailable access is reported.
limits.helius_program_effects: SOL program/rent effects and token deltas require review. Wrapped SOL, rent and Token-2022 extensions are not fully classified.
limits.helius_fungible_scope: NFTs and unclassified zero-decimal SPL mints are excluded from fungible holdings/history; omitted cached holdings remain stale.

ops.restoreConfirm: Replace this profile with the selected backup? A safety backup of the current data will be saved first.
ops.restored: Portfolio restored. Provider keys were not imported.
ops.fileTooLarge: The backup file exceeds the size limit.
ops.safetyNote: Backups contain portfolio data and decisions, but no provider keys.
ops.nativeOnly: File export is available in the desktop application.
ops.batchHint: One address per line, up to 50 on the selected network.
ops.invalidDates: The end date must not precede the start date.
ops.policyNote: Hiding keeps portfolio totals unchanged. Excluding removes the asset from valuation and accounting; its history is preserved.

syncState.label: Synchronization status
syncState.partialHint: Available data updated. Sources may cover only part of activity; some history or prices are missing.
syncState.errorHint: Check account errors below or open Settings → Network console.

networkLog.title: Network console
networkLog.hint: Application requests to data providers. The latest 500 attempts are kept in memory, newest first. Keys, wallet addresses, URL paths, headers and response bodies are excluded. Disabling clears the log.
networkLog.paused: Display paused; requests are still recorded
networkLog.empty: No requests yet. Start a sync or test a data source connection.
networkLog.disabled: The console is off. Enable it before starting a sync to see requests.
